name: Stenopelix
isnote: Long classified as a pachycephalosaur or basal marginocephalian; later analyses (2011, 2020) place it as a basal ceratopsian near Yinlong (cited Wikipedia revision).
sum: Stenopelix is a small Early Cretaceous marginocephalian from Germany known from the impression of a skeleton lacking skull and neck.
wsnote: Estimate in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: GZG 741/2, impressions of an almost complete skeleton lacking the skull and neck — Obernkirchen Sandstein Formation (Bückeberg Fm), Germany.
material: Holotype only; casts exist in gypsum and latex.
author: Meyer 1857

images.artist: Richard J. Butler and Robert M. Sullivan
images.caption: Pelvis of Stenopelix.
